logical_contracts.name: fresh-chat-authority
logical_contracts.invariant: A fresh chat reads skill, MAINTAINING, handoff, STATE, TRACKER, todo/lessons, then current code/evidence; prior chat history is not authoritative.

logical_contracts.name: provider-core-ownership
logical_contracts.invariant: YouTube reference grammar and leaf player option validation have one dependency-free owner shared by gallery and player.

logical_contracts.name: acyclic-extension-graph
logical_contracts.invariant: _sphinxcontrib_youtube never imports _sphinx_youtube_gallery; gallery and leaf player may depend on _sphinx_youtube_core.
logical_contracts.verification: common effective runtime graph gate (AST imports + declared dynamic runtime edges)

logical_contracts.name: offline-build-determinism
logical_contracts.invariant: Normal gallery rendering performs no network acquisition; sync/acquisition remains explicit tooling.

logical_contracts.name: shared-collection-engine
logical_contracts.invariant: Gallery filtering/browser metadata and card/grid presentation stay delegated to shared engines rather than duplicated in YouTube adapter.

logical_contracts.name: bounded-inputs-and-network
logical_contracts.invariant: YAML, query fields, thumbnail fetches, query parameters, and dynamic resolver paths stay bounded and fail closed with useful diagnostics.

logical_contracts.name: namespace-portability
logical_contracts.invariant: The subsystem can be verified in standalone _sphinx_ext and scikitplot._externals._sphinx_ext layouts without hard-coded parent counts.

logical_contracts.name: evidence-authority
logical_contracts.invariant: Historical standalone validation JSON/SHA files are immutable provenance, not silently refreshed as current wide-repository evidence.

logical_contracts.name: typed-dependency-classification
logical_contracts.invariant: Every gallery-family relationship is classified once as runtime-required/optional, test-only, maintenance-only, or family-related, with executable evidence rather than an ambiguous dependency list.

logical_contracts.name: capability-single-ownership
logical_contracts.invariant: Each shared capability has one family-wide owner, and every dependency edge cites capabilities owned by its target so fixes route to the correct package instead of duplicating logic.
logical_contracts.verification: family capability registry + architecture report + negative ownership tests
